title: TyrQuake
wikitext:
QuakeWorld client based on id's original one.

== Features ==

* NetQuake & QuakeWorld support
* software & OpenGL rendering
* runs on Windows, Mac OS X, Linux, FreeBSD & OpenBSD
* supports maps with extended limits, including BSP2 support
* supports FitzQuake and BJPQuake network protocols
